profile.headline: Software Engineer Tech Lead @ USAA | AI/ML Enthusiasts
profile.summary: A Software Engineer with proven proficiency in web application development, SharePoint, and business intelligence. Proven ability to understand and transform business requirements into software, ensuring applications are delivered on time, to specification, scalable, and maintainable. Experience with non-Microsoft technologies including jQuery, Bootstrap, NHibernate and Oracle. A highly motivated individual who is always learning, able to work to tight deadlines, and who can communicate effectively.

positions.title: Data Science Fellow – Financial Crimes & Fraud Detection | 2025
positions.description:
• Drove a $14M+ business impact by implementing a segment-aware fraud detection model and threshold optimization rule improving early identification of  scams.
• Created a real-time risk scoring framework leveraging probability-based thresholds per fraud segment, increasing detection precision while minimizing false positives.
• Developed reusable Python workflows for ingestion, transformation, and metadata tagging in Snowflake, reducing data duplication by 60%.
• Partnered with executives and fraud analysts to translate model outputs into actionable business rules supporting automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: Skills: R (Programming Language) · Java · Apache Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Leadership · Agile Methodologies · Technical Requirements · C# · Technical Leadership · Snowflake · Domino · Leading Development Teams · Technical Design

positions.title: Tech Equity Collective | Tech Prep Rising Innovator
I/S Specialist
positions.description:
As an I/S Specialist I am responsible for a combination of technical duties including .Net application development, SharePoint administration/ development, requirements gathering and support.  I’m responsible for numerous in house projects including 3rd party integration and played a major role in the migration of the company’s intranet from SAP to SharePoint 2013.  

-  Mobile Application Development
- .Net MVC 5 Application Development

Key Technologies: ASP.Net, MVC 5, C#, HTML, CSS, jQuery, JavaScript, Bootstrap, SQL,
Entity Framework. TFS, Visual Source Safe, XSLT, XML, ENSYS, SSIS, and SSRS
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

positions.title: I/S Analyst
positions.description:
- Successfully design, develop and support web applications for various departments within the company and store operations. 
- Create well-formed reports and sub reports for internal applications and SharePoint using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). 
- Experience in Extracting, Transforming and Loading (ETL) data from Excel, Flat files, SharePoint List, Microsoft SQL and Oracle using SSIS services.
- Spearheaded the migration of application from Visual SourceSafe (VSS) to Team Foundation Server (TFS).
- Developed the information architecture and security design for SharePoint 2013 intranet portal.
- Enhanced SharePoint user interfaces and web parts using Master Pages, Display Templates, CSS,    JavaScript, HTML, XSLT, XML and SharePoint search. 
- SharePoint development using InfoPath and SharePoint Designer to create forms, custom lists, libraries and workflows.
- Effectively test, deploy and integrate third party SharePoint solutions.
- Perform SharePoint upgrade and Cumulative Update patches.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

positions.title: Sr. Consultant
positions.description:
Served as the primary .NET developer on a SharePoint 2007 project solution that tracked basic training information and material for soldiers in the US Army.

•	Developed and refactored over 80 custom web parts using VB.Net, AJAX, JavaScript, SQL Server 2005 and NHibernate Object-relational mapping.
•	Performed software analysis on software solutions to eliminate code redundancies and circular dependencies resulting in fewer bugs, faster compile time, and easier code maintainability.
•	Optimized numerous stored procedures and views improving speeds by sometimes up to 90%.
•	Reduced the time taken to find trainee information by building a custom web part that allowed users to visualize trainee information at each US base.
•	Authored extensive client deliverable detailing software technologies used in projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed a low cost graphical user interface, designed to allow users management of streaming video, using C and OpenGL programming languages. 
- Diagnosed and resolved hardware/software issues during integration of numerous project configurations. 
- Intermittent work with GigE vision’s streaming protocol and other machine vision technologies. 
- Wrote detailed installation and procedural manuals for customer support.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Served as the primary technical lead throughout the development of a web based .NET application used for metric collection and project cost estimation.
- Cut cost of development by using database driven web pages, allowing for easy web page design and updates.  
- Wrote, reviewed, and optimized SQL queries, stored procedures, and views to achieve maximum efficiency, populate custom reporting tables and views, automatically delete expiring database entries, send automatic account alerts, and allow users search functionality using custom developed search engines. 
- Reduced user complaints by creating a user feedback system used to track concerns, bugs, and defects regarding the use of the application. 
- Communicated with all business levels during requirements analysis and testing phases.
